### SCENE 1 — SUNNY FOREST PATH

**Time: 0–18 sec**

**[Wide shot]**
A bright forest. Milo the squirrel is carrying a tiny red apple toward his treehouse.

**Milo:**
“Finally! The biggest apple in the forest!”

He suddenly hears a voice.

**Toby:**
“Milo! Wait!”

Toby runs toward him, holding a small watering can.

**Milo:**
“What happened?”

**Toby:**
“I promised to help you water your little tree… but I forgot.”

Milo looks disappointed.

**Milo:**
“You forgot again?”

Toby lowers his head.

**Toby:**
“I’m sorry. Give me one more chance.”

---

### SCENE 2 — LITTLE WOODEN TREEHOUSE

**Time: 18–38 sec**

**[Cut to treehouse]**

Milo and Toby arrive at a tiny plant beside the treehouse. The plant is dry and drooping.

Toby carefully pours water onto it.

**Toby:**
“There. I won’t forget anymore.”

Milo smiles.

**Milo:**
“Promises aren’t about saying them…”

Toby looks at him.

**Milo:**
“They’re about keeping them.”

The little plant slowly lifts its leaves.

**Toby:**
“Wow! It worked!”

Milo laughs.

---

### ENDING — TREEHOUSE

**Time: 38–46 sec**

Toby cuts the apple in half and gives one piece to Milo.

**Toby:**
“Friends share apples… and keep promises.”

**Milo:**
“Now THAT is a promise!”

They laugh together.

**[Camera pulls back]**
The two friends sit under the tree as the leaves gently move in the breeze.

**END.**

TIME: 00:00 - 00:05

ALEX (30s, sharp, trench coat) walks with confident stride through a rain-slicked Tokyo street. Neon signs glow, reflecting off the wet pavement and surrounding buildings. Rain falls steadily.

SOUND: RAIN on pavement. Distant CITY HUM. Wet FOOTSTEPS. Faint JAZZ from a nearby bar.

He pauses momentarily under a vibrant NEON sign, raising his wrist. TIGHT ON: The ChronoMaster on his wrist, the light reflecting off its polished steel.

His eyes glance at the watch face. A quick CUT to a PUDDLE REFLECTION: revealing the sleek, dark silhouette of a luxury sports car parked discreetly nearby, waiting.

"Time waits for no one. You shape it."


CLOSE UP - CHRONOMASTER DIAL - NIGHT
TIME: 00:20 - 00:30

SLOW PUSH IN to the ChronoMaster watch face. The emerald LUMINOUS HANDS GLOW softly, moving with absolute, silent precision. Residual water droplets on the sapphire crystal catch the light.

SOUND: Amplified, crisp TICKING. Rising, elegant ORCHESTRAL MUSIC swells.

FINAL HERO PRODUCT SHOT: The ChronoMaster logo and Swiss Made proudly displayed.

SUPERIMPOSE: CHRONOMASTER. SWISS.

VOICEOVER
"ChronoMaster. Master your moment."

FADE TO BLACK.

shots.prompt: The PROTAGONIST pulls back a wet cuff from their dark coat. A close-up reveals a vintage wristwatch. Rain beads on its glass as the second hand advances steadily, creating a sense of impending action.
shots.audioCue: Rain on watch, subtle ticking of watch.

shots.title: Halting Gaze
shots.cameraMotion: Slight track back as they slow, then static lock
shots.prompt: The PROTAGONIST takes two slower, deliberate steps, then stops completely. Their eyes, partially shadowed beneath the brim of a hat, slowly lift from the watch to scan the rain-blurred street ahead.
shots.audioCue: Footsteps cease. Rain continues. Low electrical hum.

shots.title: The Whisper
shots.cameraMotion: Static lock on face, then slow pan down to wrist
shots.prompt: A close-up on the PROTAGONIST's face. Rain streaks across their features. Their lips barely move as they whisper, 'Not yet.' Their gaze remains fixed for a beat, then slowly drops back down to their wristwatch.
shots.audioCue: PROTAGONIST (whispering): 'Not yet.' Rain and low hum.

shots.title: The Strike of Twelve
shots.cameraMotion: Static lock on watch, then subtle push-out as wrist lowers
shots.prompt: Extreme close-up of the wristwatch. The second hand ticks deliberately, agonizingly, until it perfectly aligns with the twelve o'clock mark. The PROTAGONIST exhales a silent breath. Their lips form 'Now' as they slowly lower their wrist out of frame.

shots.title: Disappearing Figure
shots.cameraMotion: Tracking from behind, slowly pulling back
shots.prompt: The PROTAGONIST walks away from the camera with a new, quicker, and more deliberate stride. Neon lights and rain soften their silhouette as they recede into the street. The camera holds as they become a distant, dissolving figure, then fades to black.
shots.audioCue: Quicker footsteps, fading. Rain continues, then two final footsteps followed by abrupt silence.

e1d84cf9-4be2-41c5-9597-43baf4cb01ad.title: The Plug-In - Heroic Close-Up
e1d84cf9-4be2-41c5-9597-43baf4cb01ad.prompt: Sweat beads on Alex's brow as his gloved fingers deftly plug a multi-connector data jack into a glowing port on the core server. The server reacts instantly, its red light flaring brighter, digital tendrils appearing on its surface. Alex's datapad screen rapidly fills with cascading code.

09ac8870-fd6e-470e-9f11-59190043694c.title: Resistance - Dramatic Action
09ac8870-fd6e-470e-9f11-59190043694c.prompt: Alex strains, knuckles white, as electrical arcs crackle aggressively around the data jack and across the core server's surface. His face contorts with effort as he furiously types on his datapad, fighting against the AI's digital defenses. The chamber lights flicker violently.

81adaf3f-df18-4c84-8042-6d46428d8b2b.prompt: The core server abruptly goes dark, its red pulse extinguished, leaving the chamber in stark shadow, save for Alex's flashlight. He pulls the data jack free, panting heavily, and stares at the now-inert monolith. A weary but triumphant look crosses his face as he takes in the silent chamber.
